items.q: Mammillated eggs with fleeting lung infiltrates then small bowel obstruction in a child is what?
o: Ascaris with albendazole and surgical milking if obstructed
items.exp: Hepatopulmonary migration precedes luminal bolus; drugs paralyse with obstruction milked surgically. Hookworm anaemias without plugs.
items.kp: Mammillated plus Loeffler plus plug: Ascaris.

items.q: Biliary colic with worms on ERCP in ascariasis is managed how?
items.exp: Migrating adults lodge in ducts causing cholangitis and pancreatitis; endoscopy retrieves with drugs preventing return. Surgery reserves perforation.

items.q: Ground itch with microcytic anaemia and eosinophilia in a barefoot farmer is hookworm; therapy is what?
o: Albendazole plus iron replacement with footwear
items.exp: Chronic intestinal oozing depletes iron while worms persist; deworming with replenishment and shoes cures. Transfusion bridges severe cases.
items.kp: Itchy feet plus pale blood: hookworm.

items.q: Racing wheals with Gram negative sepsis after steroids in a migrant is Strongyloides hyperinfection; drug of choice is what?
o: Ivermectin urgently with broad antibiotics and steroids stopped
items.exp: Autoinfection explodes disseminating larvae carrying gut flora; ivermectin daily until clear with sepsis cover saves. Albendazole is second line.

items.q: Nocturnal perianal itch in siblings is pinworm; diagnosis and control are what?
o: Morning NIH swab with whole family mebendazole repeated in 2 weeks
items.exp: Eggs deposit nocturnally missing routine stools; household cycles demand synchronous dosing with nail and linen hygiene. Appendiceal migrants rarely operate.
items.kp: Night itch siblings: NIH, family treats.

items.q: Pork meal followed by periorbital oedema, myalgia and marked eosinophilia is Trichinella; therapy is what?
o: Albendazole plus steroids for muscle phase inflammation
items.exp: Nurse cells inflame as larvae encyst; killing without steroids worsens myositis while cardiac and CNS watched. Cooking prevents.

items.q: Nocturnally periodic microfilariae with elephantiasis and hydrocele suggest bancrofti; therapy is what?
o: DEC plus doxycycline for Wolbachia with limb hygiene
items.exp: Doxycycline sterilises endosymbionts cutting transmission with macrofilaricidal aid; DEC kills microfilariae while hygiene shrinks limbs. Surgery suits hydrocele.
items.kp: Night worms big leg: DEC plus doxy.

items.q: Eye worm crossing conjunctiva with Calabar swellings after Central Africa is Loa; caution with DEC is what?
o: Encephalopathy in heavy loads needing steroids with apheresis debated
items.exp: Mass microfilarial killing inflames brain fatally; loading quantified with steroids covering while ivermectin suits low loads. Chrysops vectors confirm.
items.kp: Eye worm heavy load: steroids with DEC.

items.q: River blindness with hanging groin and leopard skin near fast rivers is onchocerciasis; control is what?
o: Yearly ivermectin with vector control, DEC avoided in eye disease
items.exp: Microfilariae in skin and eyes die safely with ivermectin; DEC provokes Mazzotti ocular damage while blackfly control with nodulectomy helps. Doxycycline sterilises adults.
items.kp: River skin eyes: ivermectin, never DEC.

items.q: Blister with emerging thin worm after well water exposure historically is guinea worm; eradication rests on what?
o: Safe water with cyclops filtering and wound stick extraction
items.exp: No drug or vaccine exists; cloth filtration with temephos and case containment neared eradication. Slow stick winding extracts.
items.kp: Guinea worm: filter water, wind out.
